sources.title: GLM-5.3 | OpenLM.ai
sources.snippet: GLM-5.3 is our latest flagship model for coding and long-horizon tasks. It marks a substantial leap in long-horizon task capability over its predecessor GLM-5.1 and delivers that capability on a solid 1M-token context. It is pure open with an MIT open-source license — no regional limits, technical access without borders.

sources.title: GLM-5.3 & GLM-5.2 & GLM-5.1 & GLM-5 - GitHub
sources.snippet: GLM-5.3 uses the same base model as GLM-5.2 — every gain comes from post-training. Compared with GLM-5.2, it is much better at complex coding and long-horizon tasks: Stronger Coding: GLM-5.3 is the most capable open-weights model for coding, with a 50% improvement over GLM-5.2 on our in-house Z.ai Code Bench. sources.title: GLM-5.3 - lmstudio.ai
sources.snippet: GLM-5.3 is Z.ai's 753B Mixture-of-Experts model for complex software engineering and long-horizon agentic work, with 40B active parameters and up to 1M tokens of architectural context.
